answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 36594 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: In a room, I am sitting with my religious tablighi cousin sister Question: In a room, I am sitting with my religious tablighi cousin sister. I just get up, opened the door outside, it's very dark outside and I shout "Umar bin Farooq! Umar bin Farooq!" to meet Umar (Radhiallahu Anhu). I go back and sit down and suddenly I hear his footsteps from outside and I feel very excited as he is coming to meet us. Answer ID: 36594 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 269/152/H=1433) In-sha-Allah, you shall earn the blessings of the holy Quran, firmness in religion, hospitality and simplicity. It is very nice dream. May Almighty Allah grant you always with its fruits and blessings and grant you the boons of both the worlds. Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
